safety.statement: Each endpoint has exactly one authoritative active epoch.
Candidate or pending keys cannot authorize normal commands.
A recovery request alone cannot activate a new operational key.
Replayed identifiers and lower epochs are rejected.
After VERIFIED, compromised key references cannot authenticate accepted commands.
Conflicting epochs cannot be simultaneously authoritative.
Recovery messages bind spacecraft identity, recovery ID, target epoch, counter, and transcript.
Pending states and skipped epochs are bounded by count and lifetime.
No automatic fallback to a prior compromised epoch.

liveness.statement: Under a finite passive interval and bounded delivery, a recoverable treatment terminates in an explicit outcome.
No protocol receives a liveness claim against indefinite suppression.
Retry cannot reopen stale or replayed state.

evidence.statement: Every state-changing transition produces an append-only event.
SUCCESS requires matching ground, spacecraft, and evidence completion records.
Ordering uses simulator event sequence, not wall-clock timestamps.

baseline_expectations.statement: B0 cannot claim PCS after compromise of the OTAR-protecting master key.
B1 requires transcript completion and key confirmation; missing or reordered required material aborts the baseline exchange.
B2 offers the strongest modeled healing family but may lock out after one-sided state advancement.
